requestShape: {model, input:[{type:message, role:user, content:[{type:input_text,text}, {type:input_image,image_url:data-url}]}], stream:false, metadata:{mask_encoding:lossless, include_confidence:'true'}}
notes: Real probe 2026-10-28 on a Pixel 9 Pro XL photo. One request per prompt (Responses API, one concept each). With the Responses API default store:true, bodies above roughly 530 KB (a 1440x2560 JPEG of ~446 KB, base64-encoded) were rejected with HTTP 401 invalid_api_key while 1600 px (~270 KB) and 2048 px (~397 KB) succeeded; with store:false (now in the templates) the full-size photo succeeds too. Keep store:false on every SAM call. Latency is per prompt; a 5-prompt table scan with 3 in flight is ~2 round-trips. usage.images_processed=1 per request. table-01: laptop, toy car, knife clean; 'remote' merged the remote and the speaker into one mask; 'speaker' absent. costUsd is per request (SAM image segmentation $2.50 per 1,000 images, dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits); a 5-prompt table scan is 5 requests = $0.0125.
